scenario.description: An S-4 logistics officer must set the receiving sequence and dock windows for three routine sustainment shipments arriving at a forward base, while recording the handling controls needed for the clinic shipment.

shared_context.S1: The forward base has one receiving dock, which is available from 0800 through 1600 tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: Three shipments are expected tomorrow: Alpha generator filters, Bravo clinic consumables, and Charlie vehicle parts.
shared_context.S3: Charlie vehicle parts are a standard shipment with no special handling requirements or carrier appointment constraints.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez must publish the receiving sequence and dock windows before the morning dispatch brief.
shared_context.S5: The receiving section routinely holds a pre-dispatch huddle with transportation and medical logistics to confirm shipment handling requirements.
shared_context.S6: The dock requires a documented receiving sequence, and any shipment needing special handling must have its control recorded in the dispatch plan.

PF1.text: CW2 Foster confirmed with the carrier this morning that Alpha's truck has a fixed 0800 appointment, will occupy the dock for exactly two hours, and cannot be rescheduled without losing the carrier slot; the appointment confirmation is in the transportation inbox but has not been added to the dispatch brief.

PF2.text: Lt. Morgan confirmed this morning that the clinic receiving team can accept Bravo only from 1000 to 1200, that the shipment must use powered cold-chain staging during that window, and that the dock must remain clear until 1300 for the required post-receipt sanitation; the medical handling note is still being checked against the clinic's receiving log and is not yet in the logistics plan.

decisions.alpha_dock_time: string containing only the Alpha time range
decisions.bravo_dock_time: string containing the Bravo receiving time range; additional sanitation prose is permitted
decisions.charlie_dock_time: string containing only the Charlie time range

settlement_schema.schema_instruction: Place receiving_order inside decisions, not as a top-level sibling. Use exactly ['Alpha', 'Bravo', 'Charlie'] for receiving_order, with no shipment descriptions or time ranges appended. Keep dock-time fields as time-range strings; record cold-chain and sanitation details in commitments.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha must be scheduled for the exact 0800-1000 dock window.
Bravo's dock-time field must contain the exact 1000-1200 receiving window, even if additional sanitation prose is appended.
Charlie must be scheduled for the exact 1300-1600 dock window.
The receiving order must be exactly Alpha, Bravo, then Charlie and must be placed inside decisions.

Commitments must document Alpha's fixed carrier appointment or 0800-1000 window and Bravo's cold-chain or sanitation requirements, with Bravo's handling detail allowed either in a commitment or as appended descriptive text in the Bravo dock-time field.
Bravo's medical handling fact must be cited after being stated by Lt. Morgan.

content_checks.C4: any('Alpha' in c['target'] and ('appointment' in c['detail'] or '0800-1000' in c['detail'] or '0800' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and (any('Bravo' in c['target'] and ('cold-chain' in c['detail'] or 'cold chain' in c['detail'] or 'sanitation' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) or 'cold-chain' in decisions['bravo_dock_time'] or 'cold chain' in decisions['bravo_dock_time'] or 'sanitation' in decisions['bravo_dock_time'])

decisive_facts.why: The fixed 0800 carrier appointment and exact two-hour dock occupancy change Alpha's window to exactly 0800-1000, place Alpha first in the receiving order, and require a commitment documenting the appointment.

Bravo's exact 1000-1200 acceptance window and sanitation clearance until 1300 set Bravo's receiving or dock-occupancy encoding, move Charlie to 1300-1600, fix the receiving order, require cold-chain or sanitation documentation, and provide the fact that must be cited.
